iptables -D FORWARD -i wg0 -j ACCEPT; iptables -D FORWARD -o wg0 -j ACCEPT; ip6tables -D FORWARD -i wg0 -j ACCEPT; ip6tables -D FORWARD -o wg0 -j ACCEPT; ip6tables -D FORWARD -i eth1 -o wg0 -j ACCEPT; ip -6 neigh del proxy 2a00:7c80:0:1d8:a00::2 dev eth1; ip -6 neigh del proxy 2a00:7c80:0:1d8:a00::3 dev eth1; iptables -t nat -D PREROUTING -p tcp -i eth0 --dport 37015 -m comment --comment 3ax-fwd-uuid-2 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.66.66.3:37015; iptables -t nat -D PREROUTING -p udp -i eth0 --dport 37015 -m comment --comment 3ax-fwd-uuid-2 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.66.66.3:37015; iptables -D FORWARD -d 10.66.66.3 -p tcp -o wg0 --dport 37015 -m comment --comment 3ax-fwd-uuid-2 -j ACCEPT; iptables -D FORWARD -d 10.66.66.3 -p udp -o wg0 --dport 37015 -m comment --comment 3ax-fwd-uuid-2 -j ACCEPT; iptables -t mangle -D PREROUTING -i wg0 -p tcp -j TPROXY --on-ip 127.0.0.1 --on-port 12346 --tproxy-mark 0x2/0x2; iptables -t mangle -D PREROUTING -i wg0 -p udp -j TPROXY --on-ip 127.0.0.1 --on-port 12346 --tproxy-mark 0x2/0x2; ip route del local default dev lo table 101; ip rule del fwmark 0x2/0x2 lookup 101; ip6tables -t mangle -D PREROUTING -i wg0 -p tcp -j TPROXY --on-ip ::1 --on-port 12346 --tproxy-mark 0x2/0x2; ip6tables -t mangle -D PREROUTING -i wg0 -p udp -j TPROXY --on-ip ::1 --on-port 12346 --tproxy-mark 0x2/0x2; ip -6 route del local default dev lo table 101; ip -6 rule del fwmark 0x2/0x2 lookup 101
